title: Living & Non-living Things
subject: Integrated Studies
description: What's alive? Let's find out how to tell!

video.title: Living and Nonliving Things for Kids

steps: LIVING things grow, need food and water, breathe, and can make babies. 🌱🐶
NON-LIVING things do NOT grow or eat: rocks, chairs, toys, cars.
Plants are living too! They grow, drink water, and make seeds.
Trick check: ask 'Does it grow? Does it need food and water?' Yes + yes = living!

questions.prompt: What do ALL living things need? Pick ALL!
questions.hint: Three things every living thing needs.

questions.prompt: Is a plant living or non-living?
questions.correct: Living — it grows and drinks water
questions.hint: Walking isn't required to be alive!
options: Living — it grows and drinks water
